conversation_brief.heading: Discussing current operating conditions
conversation_brief.context: Economic and infrastructure conditions can affect industries and locations differently.
conversation_brief.starter: How are current operating conditions affecting businesses in your sector?
conversation_brief.avoid: Assuming every company or region is experiencing the same conditions.

conversation_brief.heading: Discussing practical disruption
conversation_brief.context: Service disruption can be discussed through its business effects rather than political blame.
conversation_brief.starter: Have recent infrastructure conditions changed how your organisation plans day-to-day operations?
conversation_brief.avoid: Assuming who the other person blames for a local service problem.

conversation_brief.heading: Approaching sensitive developments
conversation_brief.context: Political and social issues may be strongly felt, so neutral and open questions are safer.
conversation_brief.starter: Which recent developments are having the greatest effect on your industry?
conversation_brief.avoid: Assuming a person's political affiliation or view on a controversial issue.
